name: Reelwright
tagline: Promo videos, cut from your repo.
about:
Reelwright makes short promo videos for a project from its repo and its brand: square, vertical and landscape cuts with a voiceover, music and sound effects. It is a Claude Code plugin in the mtblck marketplace.

The mark is the three cuts it makes, drawn as frames on one centre: tall, wide, and the square in Tungsten.
construction: On a 256 grid, band 16: a 9:16 frame of 117 × 208, the same frame turned 16:9, and a square of 149 whose inner edge meets the tall frame exactly.

colors.name: Emulsion
colors.usage: The wordmark, headings, the tall and wide frames and the brand field.

colors.name: Tungsten
colors.usage: The square frame and one highlight per layout; never body text.

colors.name: Leader
colors.usage: Page backgrounds, and the mark on Emulsion or Darkroom.

colors.name: Darkroom
colors.usage: Dark pages and the dark-mode ground.
